dialogues.jp: 窓の外を眺める。
dialogues.en: I look out of the window.
dialogues.text: I look out of the window.

dialogues.jp:
たった一部屋分の違いなのに、そこから見える
景色は俺の部屋とは随分と異なる。
dialogues.en:
It's only one room away, but it's a very different view from
here.
dialogues.text:
It's only one room away, but it's a very different view from
here.

dialogues.jp: 「今日はニューハーフの日だな」
dialogues.en: "It's kind of a new day today."
dialogues.text: "It's kind of a new day today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「けほっ……な、なに言ってるの……？」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, ugh... What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Ohh, ugh... What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: ベッドにぺたんと座りながら、音夢が咳き込む。
dialogues.en: Nemu coughs, still resting her butt on the bed.
dialogues.text: Nemu coughs, still resting her butt on the bed.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、音夢の体調が悪そうだから、励まして
　やろうと思ってさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I just wanted to cheer you up, since you don't look
good."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I just wanted to cheer you up, since you don't look
good."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そ、それで……私は、なにをどう励まされれ
　ばいいの？」
dialogues.en: "So, what's up with me?"
dialogues.text: "So, what's up with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Who knows?"
dialogues.text: "Who knows?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぅ……なんでこんなんばっか……進学にも
　ドクターストップかかるし〜」
dialogues.en:
"Oh gosh, why me? I got a doctor's order not to move on to
get my master's degree."
dialogues.text:
"Oh gosh, why me? I got a doctor's order not to move on to
get my master's degree."

dialogues.jp:
ぱた、と壁によりかかる音夢の頭をポンポンと
叩いて立ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
I stand up and pat Nemu's head as she leans against the
wall.
dialogues.text:
I stand up and pat Nemu's head as she leans against the
wall.

dialogues.jp:
「そういや進学ってさ、お前、俺に黙って外の
　学校なんて受験してたのか」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, by the way, I didn't know that you took an entrance
exam for another school without telling me."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, by the way, I didn't know that you took an entrance
exam for another school without telling me."

dialogues.jp:
ぺらぺら、と届いた通知に書かれた学校名を指
差す。
dialogues.en:
I point to the name of the school on the notice that was
delivered.
dialogues.text:
I point to the name of the school on the notice that was
delivered.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……えへへへへ」
dialogues.en: "Ooops... haha..."
dialogues.text: "Ooops... haha..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのなぁ、笑い事じゃないだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Come on, this isn't funny at all."
dialogues.text: "Come on, this isn't funny at all."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんには内緒にしてたけど、お父さんとお
　母さんはＯＫしてくれたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I didn't tell you, but my dad and mom said okay."
dialogues.text: "I didn't tell you, but my dad and mom said okay."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「マジか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「マジマジ」
dialogues.en: "Completely."
dialogues.text: "Completely."

dialogues.jp: ブイ、と音夢が指を二本立てる。
dialogues.en: Nemu makes a V sign with her fingers.
dialogues.text: Nemu makes a V sign with her fingers.

dialogues.jp: 今度は俺がため息をつく番だった。
dialogues.en: This is my time to give a sigh.
dialogues.text: This is my time to give a sigh.

dialogues.jp: （とはいえ……）
dialogues.en: (But then...)
dialogues.text: (But then...)

dialogues.jp:
実際のところ、あの夜におかしかった音夢の状
態を考えれば、よほどこちらのほうがマシだろ
う。
dialogues.en:
When you think about Nemu's state of mind that night, I
think this is more serious.
dialogues.text:
When you think about Nemu's state of mind that night, I
think this is more serious.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「白衣の天使になりたかったんだけどなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I wanted to be a nurse, like an angel in white."
dialogues.text: "I wanted to be a nurse, like an angel in white."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「コスプレ趣味に目覚めたか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you wake up with an interest in dressing up?"
dialogues.text: "Did you wake up with an interest in dressing up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「慈愛の心に目覚めたんです！」
dialogues.en: "No, I woke up with a sense of charity!"
dialogues.text: "No, I woke up with a sense of charity!"

dialogues.jp: 頬をふくらませて音夢が目を逸らす。
dialogues.en: Nemu looks away, pouting.
dialogues.text: Nemu looks away, pouting.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「こう、幼い頃から病院に行っていて、看護師
　さんのやさしさに触れてね……あぁ、私もこ
　ういう人になりたいなって」
dialogues.en:
"I've been in and out of the hospital since I was little,
and I've been touched by the nurses' kindness. It made me
want to become a nurse one day."
dialogues.text:
"I've been in and out of the hospital since I was little,
and I've been touched by the nurses' kindness. It made me
want to become a nurse one day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「人の役に立つ人になりたいなって♪」
dialogues.en: "I wanted to help other people."
dialogues.text: "I wanted to help other people."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、そりゃうちの親も反対はしないだろう
　けどさぁ……唐突過ぎるだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I know my parents would like the idea, but it's kind
of a surprise."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I know my parents would like the idea, but it's kind
of a surprise."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、看護学校なんて面倒なところに行か
　なくても、お前なら、永久就職も簡単だろ
　う――って言われたけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, they said I could find somebody to marry me easily
instead of going to a nursing school."
dialogues.text:
"Well, they said I could find somebody to marry me easily
instead of going to a nursing school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……嫁ぎ先の旦那の食生活を哀れむよ俺は」
dialogues.en:
"I feel sorry for a husband-to-be when it comes to
mealtimes."
dialogues.text:
"I feel sorry for a husband-to-be when it comes to
mealtimes."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとそれ喧嘩売っ――あぅ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, are you trying to pick a fight? Ow!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, are you trying to pick a fight? Ow!"

dialogues.jp: ひょい、と音夢の胸元に手をいれる。
dialogues.en: I put my hand in Nemu's bosom.
dialogues.text: I put my hand in Nemu's bosom.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え……ええっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Oh... No, niisan... wait!"
dialogues.text: "Oh... No, niisan... wait!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ななな、なにするの兄さん……あ」
dialogues.en: "Uh, haahn... don't move it around..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, haahn... don't move it around..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「変な声を上げるな！」
dialogues.en: "Be quiet!"
dialogues.text: "Be quiet!"

dialogues.jp: 脇の下から体温計をとりだす。
dialogues.en: I take out the thermometer from her armpit.
dialogues.text: I take out the thermometer from her armpit.

dialogues.jp: 「３６度８分……ダメだな」
dialogues.en: "36.8 degrees... it's a little high."
dialogues.text: "36.8 degrees... it's a little high."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょちょちょ、ちょっと兄さん！！」
dialogues.en: "H-H-Hey, niisan!!"
dialogues.text: "H-H-Hey, niisan!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ微熱少女？」
dialogues.en: "What is it, feverish girl?"
dialogues.text: "What is it, feverish girl?"

dialogues.jp: 体温計を振りながら小さくため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I give a sigh while shaking the thermometer.
dialogues.text: I give a sigh while shaking the thermometer.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「な、な、なな、なに平然と人の胸元に手をつっ
　こんでるのよ！！」
dialogues.en:
"D-D-Do you know you're putting your hand in my bosom
without my permission?!"
dialogues.text:
"D-D-Do you know you're putting your hand in my bosom
without my permission?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あん？　兄妹だから別にいいだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Uhh? It doesn't matter, because we're brother and sister."
dialogues.text: "Uhh? It doesn't matter, because we're brother and sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄妹って……あ……いえ、兄妹でも関係ない
　でしょうが！！」
dialogues.en: "Brother and sister... That has nothing to do with it!"
dialogues.text: "Brother and sister... That has nothing to do with it!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp: そういえばそうだ。
dialogues.en: She's right.
dialogues.text: She's right.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ」
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.jp: 「普段なら気になるところだな」
dialogues.en:
Her breasts are small but nicely shaped. And the thermometer
is warm enough.
dialogues.text:
Her breasts are small but nicely shaped. And the thermometer
is warm enough.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どんなときでも気にして頂けませんか？」
dialogues.en: I could've pushed her down if I wanted.
dialogues.text: I could've pushed her down if I wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、白衣の天使になりたかったら、ゆっく
　り休んで、まず自分の身体を治せ」
dialogues.en: "Can you avoid thinking like that any time?"
dialogues.text: "Can you avoid thinking like that any time?"

dialogues.jp: ぐい、と音夢のおでこを押す。
dialogues.en:
"If you want to be an angel in white, you should take a rest
and get better soon."
dialogues.text:
"If you want to be an angel in white, you should take a rest
and get better soon."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぅ」
dialogues.en: I push her forehead.
dialogues.text: I push her forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「自分の健康管理も出来ないやつじゃあ、看護
　されるほうも不安だろうが」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う〜……は〜い。分かりました」
dialogues.en:
"Patients wouldn't feel comfortable when you're ill
yourself."
dialogues.text:
"Patients wouldn't feel comfortable when you're ill
yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあ、家にはいるから、なにかあった
　ら声をかけるか携帯をワンコール」
dialogues.en: "Ohh... Okay, I got it."
dialogues.text: "Ohh... Okay, I got it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん……ごめんね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'm going back to the house, so if you need me, call
me, or call my cell phone."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'm going back to the house, so if you need me, call
me, or call my cell phone."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今更だ」
dialogues.en: "Sure, thanks."
dialogues.text: "Sure, thanks."

dialogues.jp: 小さく笑って部屋をでようとする。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, right."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, right."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お……じゃなかった、兄さん」
dialogues.en: I go out of the room with a little smile.
dialogues.text: I go out of the room with a little smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「最近さくらちゃんを見ないんだけど、どうし
　たのかなって」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en:
"I haven't seen Sakura-chan recently. I wonder how she's
doing."
dialogues.text:
"I haven't seen Sakura-chan recently. I wonder how she's
doing."

dialogues.jp: 軽く首をかしげる。

「俺も話をしたいんだけどな。家にもいないし、
　あいつ携帯電話もってないんだよ」
dialogues.en: I tilt my head.
dialogues.text: I tilt my head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I want to talk with her, too, but she's not home, and she
doesn't have a cell phone."
dialogues.text:
"I want to talk with her, too, but she's not home, and she
doesn't have a cell phone."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Really."
dialogues.text: "Really."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ……その」
dialogues.en: "You know what?"
dialogues.text: "You know what?"

dialogues.jp: もじもじ、と音夢が布団の中で身体を縮こめる。
dialogues.en: Nemu curls up under the blanket.
dialogues.text: Nemu curls up under the blanket.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……さくらちゃん、ちっこくて可愛いよね？」
dialogues.en: "I think Sakura-chan is cute."
dialogues.text: "I think Sakura-chan is cute."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもない、おやすみ！」
dialogues.en: "Never mind. Good night!"
dialogues.text: "Never mind. Good night!"

dialogues.jp: ばさっ、と布団をかぶってしまう。
dialogues.en: She pulls the blanket over herself.
dialogues.text: She pulls the blanket over herself.

dialogues.jp: 「変なやつ」
dialogues.en: "Weird."
dialogues.text: "Weird."

dialogues.jp:
頭をかいて、ふと、部屋を出る前にカレンダー
に目をやる。
dialogues.en:
I look toward the calendar on the way out of the room,
scratching my head,
dialogues.text:
I look toward the calendar on the way out of the room,
scratching my head,

dialogues.jp: 『４月８日……新学期♪』
dialogues.en: 'April 8th... A new semester begins.'
dialogues.text: 'April 8th... A new semester begins.'

dialogues.jp:
さて、春休みの最後の思い出が音夢の看病になっ
てしまいそうな勢いだ。
dialogues.en:
I feel just sitting by her bed will be the memory for me in
this spring break.
dialogues.text:
I feel just sitting by her bed will be the memory for me in
this spring break.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "Good grief... what a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "Good grief... what a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp:
小さく呟いて、自分の部屋に帰ろうかとも思っ
たが、居間に行くことにした。
dialogues.en:
Muttering to myself, I go to the living room instead of
going back to my own room.
dialogues.text:
Muttering to myself, I go to the living room instead of
going back to my own room.

dialogues.jp:
ソファーに腰をおろして、だらっ、と足を伸ば
す。
dialogues.en: I sit down on the couch, stretching my legs.
dialogues.text: I sit down on the couch, stretching my legs.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の本校進学ストップの書類。その中に、本
校進学者の名簿も含まれていたのだ。
dialogues.en:
There are two pieces of paper there. One of them is the
doctor's order to stop Nemu from moving on to the master's
program, and the other is the list of names that are moving
on to the master's program.
dialogues.text:
There are two pieces of paper there. One of them is the
doctor's order to stop Nemu from moving on to the master's
program, and the other is the list of names that are moving
on to the master's program.

dialogues.jp: 不思議なことに。
dialogues.en: It's strange...
dialogues.text: It's strange...

dialogues.jp:
何度読み返しても、そこに芳乃さくらという名
前がなかったのだ。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the papers many times, but I couldn't find
Sakura's name.
dialogues.text:
I looked at the papers many times, but I couldn't find
Sakura's name.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の看病◆
dialogues.en: ◆Taking care of Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Taking care of Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
４月に入り、体調を崩した音夢の看病をしつつ、
どうやらこのまま春休みが終わってしまうなと
思った。
dialogues.en:
I thought my spring break would be spent just looking after
Nemu, who's been sick since the start of April.
dialogues.text:
I thought my spring break would be spent just looking after
Nemu, who's been sick since the start of April.

dialogues.jp:
そして、音夢から本当は看護系の道に進学する
予定があったことを知る。
dialogues.en:
And I found out that Nemu wanted to go to a nursing school
instead.
dialogues.text:
And I found out that Nemu wanted to go to a nursing school
instead.

dialogues.jp:
最近は、なぜかさくらの姿を見ない。なんだか
ため息をつきたいことだらけだ。
dialogues.en:
I hadn't seen Sakura for several days. I had so many things
I was wondering about.
dialogues.text:
I hadn't seen Sakura for several days. I had so many things
I was wondering about.

dialogues.jp:
本校進学者のリストの中に、音夢とさくらの名
前がなかったのが一番の原因だった。
dialogues.en:
The chief of which was that the names of Nemu and Sakura
weren't on the list of the people who're moving on to the
master's program.
dialogues.text:
The chief of which was that the names of Nemu and Sakura
weren't on the list of the people who're moving on to the
master's program.
